items.title: What are you actually doing for inventory?
items.summary: With Stocky shutting down in August, curious what people are actually doing for inventory management now. Are you moving to one of the paid apps (Inventory Planner, Prediko, etc), building something custom with Claude or n8n, or just using Shopify's native POs and hoping for the best? Genuinely curious what's working for smaller stores that don't need enterprise features.   submitted by   /u/Accomplished-Name1 [link]   [comments]
